title: anthoxanthum longifolium
intro: Anthoxanthum longifolium, commonly known as velvet grass, is a perennial grass species that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential in alleviating anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness due to its sedative and anxiolytic effects, making it a popular ingredient in herbal teas and supplements. The bioactive constituents present in velvet grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Regular consumption of velvet grass may also help in reducing stress levels, promoting relaxation, and improving overall well-being due to its adaptogenic and calming effects.
